A fantasy survival game. This milestone previews scene flow.
Movement, enemies and combat arrive in M2.

Select one weapon to preview the battle scene.
Weapon attacks and balance are not implemented in M1.
Straight projectile / nearest target. Planned for M2.
Orbiting close-range weapon. Planned for M6.
Periodic radial attack. Planned for M6.

The scene and battle clock are active.
Player movement, attacks and enemies arrive in M2.
Press ESC to pause.
Abandon this run? Unsettled currency and statistics will not be saved.
Meta upgrades and saving arrive in M4. No purchases are available.

Language, audio and display settings arrive in M8.
This M1 preview uses English placeholder text.
Permanent statistics arrive in M4. No run data is saved in M1.
LEVEL UP / Selection arrives in M3
RESULT / Settlement and saving arrive in M4
